question: shecaniah-7 is recorded with more than one father: arah-2, arah-3.

actions.why: Shecaniah is called בֶן־אָרַח, son of Arah, already represented by arah-3. Identifying this father with the Arah whose descendants appear in EZR 2:5 is unsupported by the supplied verses.

note: Keep the reciprocal relationships with arah-3 and Shecaniah's father-in-law relationship to Tobiah. The verses do not establish whether arah-2 and arah-3 are the same person, so merging them is unwarranted.
